description: Review Go code for language-level defects, including goroutine leaks, data races, unchecked or shadowed errors, context misuse, nil map writes, defer in loops, and unsafe concurrency patterns, and report findings with severity and file locations. Use when asked to review Go code, a Go diff, package, or service for Go-specific correctness and concurrency problems. Do not use for general reviews that also need security and maintainability coverage (use kit-code-review), for non-Go code, for SQL data-access review (use kit-go-sql-review), for writing new handlers (use kit-go-http-api), or for fixing a known bug (use kit-debugging); this skill reports and does not edit code.
